title: Multi-column GDN prefill supersedes the DPP route: 1.34x-1.68x

host.note: AGENTS.md's stated default hardware is W7900/gfx1100; this host is gfx1151. All figures below are gfx1151 and must not be compared against gfx1100 lanes.

headline.claim: 1.34x-1.68x faster than the DPP route across 512-4096 tokens

correctness_gate.verdict: NMSE ~1.8e-14 is fp32 round-off; indistinguishable from the reassociation floor the chunk drift screen measured (5-7e-14)

task_gate.not_a_regression: the artifact records the defects as 'shared instruction-following defects, not new candidate regressions' and 'Strict's own errors and shared omissions remain disclosed'; it also states the finding is 'not proof of worse expected quality or a GDN kernel defect'

promotion.action: production GDN prefill selection changed to qwen4exp_gdn_tiled16_multi_prefill
promotion.recovery_profile: unchanged - the multi-column route was added to the recovery path's inactive set so the arithmetic-recovery UD profile keeps its exact owners
promotion.test: tests/ -k 'profile or recovery or gdn' passes

limits: One host (gfx1151), one quant (gguf_ud_q4_k_xl), one shape family (Hk16/Hv48/Dk=Dv=128).
GDN prefill scope only; not a whole-request rate.
Not bit-exact to the DPP incumbent (NMSE 1.8e-14); admitted on the production numerical envelope.
The task finding is shared with the strict arm and is not attributable to this change, but it is recorded rather than dismissed.
